title: Recall Fee Terms of the Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
The recall figures of the Contingency Placement Agreements, by tier.

| Tier | Recall fee share (percent of the stage contingency fee)¹ | Payment lookback (calendar days)² | Free recall window (calendar days)³ | Free recall allowance (percent of placements)⁴ | Recall fee cap (USD)⁵ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 100.0 | 60 | 10 | 2.0 | 2500.00 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 100.0 | 60 | 10 | 2.0 | 2500.00 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 100.0 | 45 | 15 | 3.0 | 2000.00 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 75.0 | 45 | 20 | 5.0 | 1500.00 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 50.0 | 30 | 30 | 5.0 | 1000.00 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 50.0 | 30 | 30 | 10.0 | 1000.00 |

**Notes to the table**

1. The share of the stage contingency fee on the recalled balance that is charged as a recall fee, in percent.
2. The calendar days before the recall within which a consumer payment makes the recall chargeable.
3. The calendar days after the placement date within which a recall is free.
4. The share of the agreement's accounts placed in the trailing 12 months that may be recalled free of the arrangement and payment test, in percent.
5. The largest recall fee charged on one account, in USD.

**Hypothetical comparison.** On the Enterprise Contingency Agreement the recall fee share is 50.0 percent of the stage contingency fee and no single account's recall fee exceeds 1000.00 USD; on the Starter Contingency Agreement the share is 100.0 percent and the cap is 2500.00 USD.
